summary.name: Cerebro
summary.one_liner: Cerebro is a free, open-source, Electron-based launcher app that searches your machine and the internet, positioned as an alternative to Alfred and Spotlight.
use_cases: quickly search files and the web from one box
replace Spotlight or Alfred with a cross-platform launcher
look up maps or translations without opening another app
build custom launcher plugins via API
summary.what_it_does: Cerebro is a launcher application built with Electron. It lets you search on your machine and on the internet from one place. Results can be acted on directly, such as opening a file in its default program, revealing it in Finder, copying contact details to the clipboard, or seeing Google suggestions. It includes maps, translations and file lookup so you do not need to open separate apps. A built-in plugin manager lets you find and use plugins, and a plugin API lets developers build and share their own.
notable: Electron-based, so it supports multiple operating systems
Plugin manager plus a public plugin API for community plugins
Listed as free and open source on GitHub with about 8k stars
caveats: Page names only multiple OS support generally; specific platforms are not listed on the page beyond the awesome-mac listing context
Page lists 10+ official plugins, so some functionality depends on plugins
